commentary.text: 90+5' Jesus Gil Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+2' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Chance! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Alex Remiro is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
90+1' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Jon Aramburu.
83' The free kick from long range, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' A cross into the box from Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.

58' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

48' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Alex Remiro gets down to his right to keep it out.

41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

34' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

31' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Corner kicks – 1:0.

14' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
14' Real Sociedad enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

6' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
4' Ath Bilbao are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
